messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing as open source frameworks hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling across the industry. Startups are quietly replacing hand coded orchestration with model driven agents, fundamentally shifting the development paradigm. Concurrently, tool calling reliability has emerged as the critical new benchmark for evaluating frontier models. In the enterprise sector, multi agent swarms are moving from early demonstrations to fully regulated workflows. To support this complex deployment, new observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end, ensuring accountability and robust performance throughout the ecosystem.
